verses.en: The song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
verses.pt: O cântico dos cânticos, que é de Salomão.
verses.en_web: The Song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
verses.en_bbe: The song of Songs, which is Solomon's.

verses.en: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.
verses.pt: Beije-me ele com os beijos da sua boca; porque melhor é o seu amor do que o vinho.
verses.en_web: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.
verses.en_bbe: Let him give me the kisses of his mouth: for his love is better than wine.

verses.en: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
verses.pt: Suave é o cheiro dos teus perfumes; como perfume derramado é o teu nome; por isso as donzelas te amam.
verses.en_web: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
verses.en_bbe: Sweet is the smell of your perfumes; your name is as perfume running out; so the young girls give you their love.

verses.en: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
verses.pt: Leva-me tu; correremos após ti. O rei me introduziu nas suas recâmaras; em ti nos alegraremos e nos regozijaremos; faremos menção do teu amor mais do que do vinho; com razão te amam.
verses.en_web: Take me away with you. Let us hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. Friends We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will praise your love more than wine! Beloved They are right to love you.
verses.en_bbe: Take me to you, and we will go after you: the king has taken me into his house. We will be glad and full of joy in you, we will give more thought to your love than to wine: rightly are they your lovers.

verses.en: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
verses.pt: Eu sou morena, mas formosa, ó filhas de Jerusalém, como as tendas de Quedar, como as cortinas de Salomão.
verses.en_web: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.
verses.en_bbe: I am dark, but fair of form, O daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

verses.en: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother’s children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.
verses.pt: Não repareis em eu ser morena, porque o sol crestou-me a tez; os filhos de minha mãe indignaram-se contra mim, e me puseram por guarda de vinhas; a minha vinha, porém, não guardei.
verses.en_web: Don’t stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has scorched me. My mother’s sons were angry with me. They made me keeper of the vineyards. I haven’t kept my own vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: Let not your eyes be turned on me, because I am dark, because I was looked on by the sun; my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vine-gardens; but my vine-garden I have not kept.

verses.en: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
verses.pt: Dize-me, ó tu, a quem ama a minha alma: Onde apascentas o teu rebanho, onde o fazes deitar pelo meio-dia; pois, por que razão seria eu como a que anda errante pelos rebanhos de teus companheiros?
verses.en_web: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; For why should I be as one who is veiled beside the flocks of your companions?
verses.en_bbe: Say, O love of my soul, where you give food to your flock, and where you make them take their rest in the heat of the day; why have I to be as one wandering by the flocks of your friends?

verses.en: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds’ tents.
verses.pt: Se não o sabes, ó tu, a mais formosa entre as mulheres, vai seguindo as pisadas das ovelhas, e apascenta os teus cabritos junto às tendas dos pastores.
verses.en_web: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.
verses.en_bbe: If you have not knowledge, O most beautiful among women, go on your way in the footsteps of the flock, and give your young goats food by the tents of the keepers.

verses.en: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots.
verses.pt: A uma égua dos carros de Faraó eu te comparo, ó amada minha.
verses.en_web: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.
verses.en_bbe: I have made a comparison of you, O my love, to a horse in Pharaoh's carriages.

verses.en: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.
verses.pt: Formosas são as tuas faces entre as tuas tranças, e formoso o teu pescoço com os colares.
verses.en_web: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.
verses.en_bbe: Your face is a delight with rings of hair, your neck with chains of jewels.

verses.en: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
verses.pt: Nós te faremos umas tranças de ouro, marchetadas de pontinhos de prata.
verses.en_web: We will make you earrings of gold, with studs of silver.
verses.en_bbe: We will make you chains of gold with ornaments of silver.

verses.en: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
verses.pt: Enquanto o rei se assentava à sua mesa, dava o meu nardo o seu cheiro.
verses.en_web: While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
verses.en_bbe: While the king is seated at his table, my spices send out their perfume.

verses.en: A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
verses.pt: O meu amado é para mim como um saquitel de mirra, que repousa entre os meus seios.
verses.en_web: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh, that lies between my breasts.
verses.en_bbe: As a bag of myrrh is my well-loved one to me, when he is at rest all night between my breasts.

verses.en: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi.
verses.pt: O meu amado é para mim como um ramalhete de hena nas vinhas de En-Gedi.
verses.en_web: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.
verses.en_bbe: My love is to me as a branch of the cypress-tree in the vine-gardens of En-gedi.

verses.en: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes.
verses.pt: Eis que és formosa, ó amada minha, eis que és formosa; os teus olhos são como pombas.
verses.en_web: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are doves.
verses.en_bbe: See, you are fair, my love, you are fair; you have the eyes of a dove.

verses.en: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
verses.pt: Eis que és formoso, ó amado meu, como amável és também; o nosso leito é viçoso.
verses.en_web: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, yes, pleasant; and our couch is verdant.
verses.en_bbe: See, you are fair, my loved one, and a pleasure; our bed is green.

verses.en: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.
verses.pt: As traves da nossa casa são de cedro, e os caibros de cipreste.
verses.en_web: The beams of our house are cedars. Our rafters are firs.
verses.en_bbe: Cedar-trees are the pillars of our house; and our boards are made of fir-trees.
